definitions.explanation: The direction opposite to the one currently being discussed or traveled. Commonly used for trains, roads, and general orientation.

examples.japanese: {逆方向|ぎゃくほうこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I accidentally got on a train going in the opposite direction.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{逆方向|ぎゃくほうこう}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{引|ひ}き{返|かえ}そう→引き返す：05872_hikikaesu⟧。
examples.english: This road goes the wrong way, so let's turn back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{逆方向|ぎゃくほうこう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いて→吹く：02445_fuku⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漕|こ}ぐ→漕ぐ：04264_kogu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だった。
examples.english: The wind was blowing from the opposite direction, so it was tough pedaling the bicycle.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound noun formed from ⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧ (reverse, opposite) + ⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧ (direction). Very common in daily conversation, especially when talking about transportation mistakes or navigation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆方向|ぎゃくほうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (to go in the opposite direction)
- {逆方向|ぎゃくほうこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧ (a train going the other way)
- {逆方向|ぎゃくほうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to run in the opposite direction)
- {逆方向|ぎゃくほうこう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (to come from the opposite direction)
